summary: Adds Command-6 map navigation and full-page map output for history exports.

new_features: Command-6 now opens the dose map from the Open Tabs menu.
minor_improvements: History PDF export and print can include a full-page rendered visual map with dose markers.
Map-only exports are now supported when location output is selected.
bug_fixes: The include-map export option now produces a visual map page instead of only listing location text.
